about: Broken copies of examples/receivers-01. The refund transactions are the real ones; only the list of refund addresses in disclosure.json changes. Each copy passes every other check and fails refund-receivers.

copies.name: 01-refund-to-other-address
copies.story: Carol's bid names her own address, but the refund the seller paid for it went to a different address. The amount and the memo are right, so the older checks pass. Only the receiver check sees it.

copies.name: 02-refund-address-not-listed
copies.story: The seller lists a refund address for three of the four bids and leaves Carol's out. Once a seller lists refund addresses, every refunded bid needs one.
